suggestions.title: Your Deutschlandticket may become redundant from SS2027
suggestions.body: From Summer Semester 2027, your university fee will include a Deutschlandsemesterticket. Since your separate Deutschlandticket Abonnement costs €756 a year, it could be worth comparing before it renews again.
suggestions.rationale: Hochschule Musterstadt's letter (doc_nba3k0ka85q0) notes the semester ticket will be included from SS2027, while you also hold a standalone Deutschlandticket Abonnement (ctr_cmeadtk38mac).

suggestions.title: Girokonto fee rising to €6.90 — a moment to compare accounts
suggestions.body: Musterbank is raising the Girokonto Klassik fee from €4.90 to €6.90 per month from 01.12.2026. Since you'll need to give explicit consent anyway, it could be a good time to compare other current-account offers.
suggestions.rationale: Musterbank's letter (doc_0b2t88kqsf2n) announces the fee increase for your Girokonto Klassik (ctr_611d1sk7v1cr).

suggestions.title: Electricity minimum term is over — worth comparing tariffs
suggestions.body: The minimum term on your Stromliefervertrag ended 30 Sep 2026, so you can now switch with one month's notice. At €48/month (€576/year), it may be worth comparing other electricity tariffs.
suggestions.rationale: The rules summary for ctr_bbzemyapzvm5 shows the minimum term has ended and lists a monthly cost of €48.

suggestions.title: Prepare documents and card payment for the Ausländerbehörde
suggestions.body: Your residence permit extension appointment on 14 Oct 2026 requires original documents and a €100 fee payable only by card. It may help to gather everything and confirm you have a suitable card beforehand.
suggestions.rationale: The Ausländerbehörde invitation (doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj) specifies required originals and card-only payment for the appointment.

suggestions.title: Send your new enrolment certificate to FitWell
suggestions.body: FitWell asks for a current Immatrikulationsbescheinigung each semester to keep your student rate. You now have the Winter 2026/27 certificate from Hochschule Musterstadt, so it's worth forwarding it.
suggestions.rationale: Item itm_9pe1yez2k9k9 requires a semester enrolment certificate for your FitWell contract (ctr_15banyk4pc92), and doc_50t54msvdfcy is your new certificate.

suggestions.title: Send your new enrolment certificate to Muster Tech GmbH
suggestions.body: Your Werkstudent contract requires submitting a fresh enrolment certificate each semester to keep your student status. Your new Winter 2026/27 certificate from Hochschule Musterstadt is ready to forward.
suggestions.rationale: Item itm_vrtb25ccjmkt lists this requirement for your employment contract (ctr_jgb50bejm6jd), and doc_50t54msvdfcy is the certificate you now have.
